FedRAMP partner enablement

ProblemPartners building for US government customers needed FedRAMP-ready apps, and every one of them was waiting on compliance, security and product at once.
I didBecame the single point of contact: translated control requirements into plain steps, chased sign-offs across three teams and ran the onboarding end to end.
Result34 partners onboarded and 40 apps registered, with developers unblocked instead of stuck in a queue.
· Platform quality43+

Bugs & improvements filed

ProblemThe same platform issues kept resurfacing in different tickets, costing partners and support the same hours over and over.
I didTurned each pattern into a JAC ticket with clean repro steps, impact and affected customers, then followed it through with engineering.
Result43+ fixes and improvements filed; several shipped as real engineering changes for every developer on the platform.
· Automation1×

Obsdeck traceability

ProblemRoot-causing incidents depended on memory and whoever happened to be on shift.
I didInitiated an Obsdeck integration so incident data was traceable from first report to fix.
ResultRoot cause from data instead of recollection, and faster, repeatable incident analysis.
· EnablementDocs

Onboarding guides & playbooks

ProblemNew teammates across locations ramped at different speeds depending on who sat next to them.
I didWrote the onboarding guides, internal docs and Loom walkthroughs for the tools and flows people hit in week one.
ResultA consistent ramp across sites, and a knowledge base people still point new starters to.
· ShipIt2

Hackathon projects

Okta SCIM integrations
